title: Glasseek: A Transparent Recipe for Training and Trustworthy Evaluation of DeepSearch Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.16998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep search enables language agents to solve complex information-seeking tasks through iterative web exploration. However, developing robust open-source agents remains challenging for three reasons. First, opaque trajectory-construction pipelines make training data difficult to audit and reproduce. Second, context compression can create a substantial mismatch between training and inference. Third, agents may retrieve benchmark content from the open web during evaluation, contaminating the results and overstating their performance. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce Glasseek, a fully transparent deep search framework spanning the complete development lifecycle, releasing all data, model weights, training recipes, and code. Specifically, for data construction, we establish a verifiable trajectory curation pipeline that systematically generates high-quality exploration paths. translated_abstract: 深度搜索使语言智能体能够通过迭代的网络探索来解决复杂的信息获取任务。然而，开发强大的开源智能体仍然面临三大挑战。首先，不透明的轨迹构建流程使得训练数据难以审计和复现。其次，上下文压缩会在训练和推理之间造成显著的失配。第三，智能体可能在评估过程中从开放网络中检索到基准测试内容，从而污染结果并高估其性能。为了克服这些瓶颈，我们提出了Glasseek，这是一个覆盖完整开发生命周期的完全透明的深度搜索框架，发布了所有数据、模型权重、训练方案和代码。具体而言，在数据构建方面，我们建立了一个可验证的轨迹筛选流程，系统地生成高质量的探索路径。在训练方面，我们提出了压缩管理的GSPO（CM-GSP
tldr: Glasseek是一个覆盖完整开发生命周期、全透明开源的深度搜索智能体框架，通过可验证的轨迹筛选流程和压缩管理训练方法，解决了训练数据不可审计、训练与推理失配以及基准污染三大难题。
en_tdlr: Glasseek is a fully transparent open-source deep search framework covering the complete development lifecycle, which addresses untraceable training data, train-inference mismatch, and benchmark contamination through a verifiable trajectory curation pipeline and compaction-managed training.
